skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 150% ATK DMG to a single target and restores own HP equal to 150% of own ATK.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Performs a 5-hit attack, dealing a total of 600% ATK DMG to all enemies. If the target has [Unyielding], [Specialized Unyielding], or [Specialized HP], Boros enters the [Enrage] state, increasing ATK by 50% for his next active action.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Before casting the Ultimate, Boros gains 30% Drain Rate for 1 round. Performs a 5-hit attack, dealing a total of 800% ATK DMG to all enemies. If the target has [Unyielding], [Specialized Unyielding], or [Specialized HP], Boros enters the [Enrage] state, increasing ATK by 100% for his next active action.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: After Boros or an adjacent ally takes action, they can trigger [Breakthrough]. [Breakthrough] immediately removes [Specialized Unyielding] from all targets on the battlefield. This effect lasts for 2 rounds. Before each round, restores all allies’ HP equal to 300% of each ally’s Max HP for 2 rounds. Boros permanently gains 50% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: After any ally takes action, they can trigger [Breakthrough]. [Breakthrough] immediately removes [Specialized Unyielding] from all targets on the battlefield. This effect lasts for 2 rounds. Before each round, restores all allies’ HP equal to 350% of each ally’s Max HP for 2 rounds. Boros permanently gains 55% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: After any ally takes action, they can trigger [Breakthrough]. [Breakthrough] immediately removes [Specialized Unyielding] from all targets on the battlefield. This effect lasts for 2 rounds. Before each round, restores all allies’ HP equal to 350% of each ally’s Max HP for 3 rounds. Boros permanently gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Basic Core: Grants 3 Energy every round. During the first 3 rounds, all allies gain 30% [Arena DMG]. Requirement: Deploy 1 Grappler and 2 Espers. Advanced Core: All allied characters permanently gain [Excess Recovery] upon entering battle. All allies gain 30% [Arena DMG Free]. At the beginning of each round, front-row allies restore HP equal to 80% of their Max HP. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. [Excess Recovery]: Excess Healing and Drain are converted into an equal amount of [HP Shield] that absorbs incoming DMG. The total amount of DMG absorbed cannot exceed 20× the unit’s original HP. Requirement: Deploy 1 Duelist, 1 Grappler, and 2 Espers.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Grants 3 Energy every round. During the first 3 rounds, all allies gain 50% [Arena DMG]. When an ally triggers [Pursuit], gains 1 additional Energy. Can trigger once per round.

skills.name: Awaken 3 Passive
skills.desc: Grants 3 Energy every round. During the first 3 rounds, all allies gain 50% [Arena DMG]. When an ally triggers [Pursuit], gains 2 additional Energy. Can trigger once per round.

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Survival buff that, when present, prevents the unit from being crited and cannot die, retaining 70% of its health for the duration of the effect.
Reduces all non-critical damage (usually to 1). Cannot survive and avoid Agility.
Cumulative explosive classes that each (up to a limit) add one target to the Ultimate skill.
